<subject>Re: Tatjana Indication</subject>
<body>
Klaus-Günter,
If you where to look at it from a day-ahead spread basis, how would this look?  I think he wants to float with a spot reference but wants some feel for what type of basis to the DA market we would use.   Its not really a firm bid since he is not really going to transact, so its really an indication of the market.  Kind of odd, but the better we make our price relative to day-ahead, the more likely we can get the business.  We should show him a strong bid subject to credit etc.   When the time comes to actually lock it in,  and most likely he will not since the units have no historical performance,  who knows what the market price  will be.

Arno
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Paffrath, Klaus-Günter
Sent: Wednesday, June 18, 2025 9:32 AM
To: Hertrampf, Arno
Cc: Reising, Lorenzo; Johann, Fritz
Subject: Tatjana Indication

Arno, here are the quarterly indications for Tatjana that we discussed:

		Q3 2025			Q4 2025			Q1 2026			Q2 2026


Wind		185			92			68			64	

Solar		74			48			41			37	


The prices indicated are for firm capacity delivered with performance guarantees. Merchant-backed products will be discounted 18%-28% on Wind and 12%-22% on Solar depending on term.
</quoted>
